dossier.title: Clear the Lane
briefing: I'm {PATRON}, running {HERE}, and pirates control the lane to our neighbour. Every trader either pays them or turns back. I'm losing money and patience. I need this cleared now.
Fly to the target station. Get through whatever they throw at you and dock. Prove the lane is open. That's all I'm asking.

lane.arrive: Fly to {TARGET} through the pirates and dock.
lane.fail: You did not reach {TARGET} before the deadline.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} at {WORLD} needs someone to clear the pirates from the lane.

rumour.far: Reports say {PATRON} at {WORLD} loses traders to pirates on the lane.
rumour.near: {PATRON} at {WORLD} sends word: the pirate lane to the neighbour needs clearing.

dossier.news: Traders report {PATRON} at {WORLD} is looking for someone to run the pirate lane.

story.opening: The commander docked at {WORLD} on day {DAY} and took a pirate-clearing contract.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, traders at {WORLD} resumed crossing the lane to the neighbour.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the pirates at {WORLD} had sealed the lane completely.

lane.success: The commander docked at {WORLD} on day {DAY}, proving the lane was open.
lane.failed: The commander did not reach {WORLD} by the deadline of day {DAY}.
